text:
maria-finance: Quick escalation  SmartBilling disputed Feb invoice. They want a chargeback and are pausing API keys. Proposing: one-time credit $38,450 + apply 15% usage discount for next 2 invoices. Need deal-desk sign-off and legal amendment. Posting reconciliation and recommended JE.

ravi-sales: Sales concurs. They're a strategic integration partner. We verbally committed a small onboarding allowance but it never flowed to billing. If we lose them now we risk delayed renewal + reference.

nate-salesops: Reconciled traffic: 1,150,000 tokens consumed; committed 900,000. Raw overage calc = $40,500. Sales onboarding allowance documented in internal thread (see link). Proposed cost-share brings credit to $38,450. Sheet: https://sheets.internal/redwood/smartbilling-recon-1863456789 (r/o).

billing-bot: Invoice summary: ```
Invoice: INV-2026-02-20
Amount due: $57,300
Lines: Base COMM-900K: $27,000; Overage 250K: $30,300
```

maria-finance: Notes: (a) onboarding allowance ~$12k not applied; (b) customer executed high-volume CI tests without dev flag; (c) tax impact minimal (credit reduces taxable revenue for period). Recommend one-time credit and short-term discount to retain.

elena-cfo: I need: 1) confirmation AR can process credit (Jose) 2) legal text that this is non-precedential 3) note in DEAL_DESK ledger for audit. Approve in principle pending legal.

jose-ar: AR ok to post credit once amendment signed. GL: 4102 Customer Credits. Suggested memo: "SmartBilling Feb recon credit - deal desk". Will need signed amendment PDF attached to the JE.

tom-legal: I'll draft an amendment with explicit "no precedent" clause and a 30-day limit on back-dated concessions. Suggest: "This one-time reconciliation credit is issued as a contractual amendment solely to resolve the invoice dispute and does not modify Redwood's standard pricing or create precedent." Will route for signatures. Any exec approval required?

ravi-sales: No exec needed if CFO signs. Customer is happy to sign an addendum via DocuSign. They prefer minimal language.

maria-finance: Draft JE for AR: ```
DR Customer Credits (4102) $38,450
CR Revenue (4001) $38,450
Memo: SmartBilling Feb one-time recon credit; attach amendment DSGN-xxxxx
``` Posting after signed doc.

elena-cfo: Approve $38,450 one-time credit + 2 invoices of 15% usage discount as an exception. Add a DEALDESK tag and escalate if similar cases >$25k become frequent. @maria-finance, proceed with amendment.

tom-legal: Uploaded amendment v1: https://legal.internal/redwood/amendments/smartbilling-recon-1863456789.pdf. DocuSign sent (Envelope: DSGN-901112). I included a record retention note to keep this in the concessions register.

billing-bot: DocuSign status: sent. Invoice INV-2026-02-20 flagged PENDING-CREDIT.

jose-ar: Once signed I'll post JE and issue credit memo CM-2026-02-SMB. Will confirm tax treatment with payroll/taxes before posting.

maria-finance: Thanks. I'll update CRM concession code: DEALDESK/ONEOFF/1863456789 and update the renewal owner. Keep channel posted when DocuSign completes. :ok_hand:

ravi-sales: Great. I'll handle customer comms and confirm when they sign.

elena-cfo: Good exception, document rationale in DEAL_DESK folder for audit. Closing thread when credit posted. :white_check_mark:
